claims.claim_text: Compressed Sparse Attention 2 把 KV cache 壓到每個 token 890 位元組，官方說法是約 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的四分之一
claims.location: #item-01 lede（H2「每個 token 只留 890 位元組」）
claims.evidence: Combined with FP4 main KV caching (E2M1 format, one E4M3 scale per 16 channels), these designs reduce the global KV cache footprint to 890 bytes per token — roughly 1/4 of DeepSeek-V4-Flash.
claims.note: Number and ratio match exactly. Partial attribution: the model card credits the 890 B figure to CSA2 *combined with* FP4 main KV caching; the lede names CSA2 alone. Not a contradiction (CSA2 is one of 'these designs'), but the FP4 half of the mechanism is elided.

claims.claim_text: 40 層的 causal encoder-decoder——20 層 causal encoder 接 20 層 decoder，552B backbone，但 prefill 每個 token 只活化 8B、decode 16B，每個 token 路由 6 個 expert
claims.evidence: a 40-layer Transformer organized as a 20-layer causal encoder followed by a 20-layer decoder … activates only 8B parameters per token during prefill and 16B during decode … 1 shared expert and 384 routed experts per MoE layer, activating 6 routed experts per token.
claims.note: All five figures present verbatim in the model card's architecture section.

claims.claim_text: 另一招 SWA Bounded Replay 只重放最近的 token 來補回缺掉的 SWA KV state，常駐 footprint 再降到大約八分之一
claims.evidence: SWA Bounded Replay reconstructs missing SWA KV states by replaying only the most recent n_win tokens, avoiding the need to persist SWA KV to SSD and reducing the persistent KV cache footprint to roughly 1/8 of that of DeepSeek-V4-Flash.
claims.note: The post's 「大約八分之一」 matches the source's hedged 'roughly 1/8'; hedging preserved.

claims.claim_text: 訓練用 45T multimodal token 從頭跑，sparse attention 在 64K 長度上訓練後外推到 1M，推理努力程度做成 1 到 100 連續可調，授權是 MIT
claims.evidence: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is trained from scratch on a multimodal corpus comprising 45T tokens, with sparse attention trained at a sequence length of 64K and context extended to 1M tokens at 34T tokens. … supports a continuously controllable reasoning effort setting (integer 1–100) … licensed under the MIT License
claims.note: All four sub-claims supported. The source adds a detail the lede omits (context extension happened at the 34T-token mark); omission, not drift.

claims.claim_text: LWN 報導貢獻者 waffle 在 8 月 24 日把 Rust 的 never type ! 穩定下來，前後兩年多，落點是 Rust 1.99
claims.location: #item-02 lede（H2「三千三百個 crate，七個真的壞了」）
claims.evidence: On August 24, after more than two years of work, Rust-compiler-contributor 'waffle' finally managed to stabilize the type. … So, starting in Rust 1.99, the never type will be stable and Infallible will be a type alias for the never type.
claims.note: Contributor name, date, duration and target release all verbatim.

claims.claim_text: crater 跑遍 crates.io 的結果是 3,300 個 crate 受影響、只有七個完全壞掉，其餘都是相依到早已修好的舊版本
claims.evidence: Waffle ran crater in April and found that, while there were 3,300 crates negatively impacted by the change, only seven were fully broken, with the rest broken by depending on old versions of libraries that had since been fixed.
claims.note: Exact match including the 'rest depend on already-fixed old versions' clause. The source dates the crater run to April, which the lede does not state; no conflict.

claims.claim_text: 後續 backport 又救回其中 1,553 個，有些維護者以版本早就 EOL 為由拒收
claims.evidence: Several library authors were willing to make the backports, but some refused on the grounds that those old versions were past their end of life...the successful backports addressed 1,553 of the failing crates.
claims.note: Both the count and the refusal reason are in the source sentence.

claims.claim_text: 而 Infallible 同時要變成 ! 的 type alias，兩個 breaking change 幾乎互相抵銷
claims.evidence: Luckily, changing the definition of Infallible and changing the default fallback type, while both breaking changes, nearly cancel out.
claims.note: Checked specifically because an adjacent source sentence ('In the 2024 edition, the fallback type was changed to ! itself, essentially canceling out the implicit conversion') describes a *different* cancellation. The lede matches the correct one: the two breaking changes cancel each other.

claims.claim_text: Bun 換掉 Zig 之後 Linux build 從 24 分 24 秒掉到 5 分 40 秒這個說法，發現 ld.lld 在 Full LTO 下就吃掉 16 分 35 秒
claims.evidence: My single-machine CI-profile replay | 24m24s | 5m40s … Original Full LTO | 24m24s | 16m35s
claims.note: The 16m35s figure appears only inside the timing table (the prose says 'over sixteen minutes, about two-thirds of the entire build'); re-fetched the table verbatim to confirm 16m35s is the Full-LTO baseline's final-linker column.

claims.claim_text: 把 Bun 自己換成 ThinLTO 只省下 3 分 40 秒，因為連進去的 WebKit 仍是 Full LTO，兩邊一起換才降到 15 分 11 秒
claims.evidence: The link got 3m40s faster in this pair of recordings, but it was still taking nearly thirteen minutes. … Bun ThinLTO; rebuilt ThinLTO WebKit and ICU | 15m11s | 7m22s
claims.note: Both numbers are in the source, but they come from different columns: 3m40s is a *link-time* delta (16m35s → 12m55s) while 15m11s is the *whole-build* total for that row (its link time is 7m22s). The lede chains them in one sentence, so a reader could take 15m11s as the link figure. Numbers correct; the referent shifts mid-sentence.

claims.claim_text: 剩下的差距來自 90 幾個 crate 能平行編譯的結構，不是語言
claims.evidence: The overwhelming difference which remained was structural: Rust spreads compilation across >90 crates while the Zig build funnelled everything through a single module! … Bun has been split into >90 crates, while in Zig it was all trying to compile as a single Zig module!
claims.note: This is the item's headline causal claim and the source states it as its own conclusion, unhedged.

claims.claim_text: Julia 1.13 在 9 月 10 日發布……GC 不再掃過預先載入的系統程式碼，bare session 的 full collection 從 35ms 掉到 2ms，載入 GLMakie 之後從 187ms 掉到 68ms
claims.evidence: Julia version 1.13 has been released … 10 September 2026 … In Julia 1.13, objects in the sysimage and in package images are loaded as permanently marked and the mark phase never enters them. … 35 ms (1.12 bare session) / 2 ms (1.13 bare session) … 187 ms (1.12 with GLMakie) / 68 ms (1.13 with GLMakie)
claims.note: Re-fetched specifically because the blog's inline @time output for the 1.13 bare session prints 0.000528 seconds (~0.5 ms), which does not agree with its own summary table's 2 ms. The post follows the source's table, so the post is faithful to what it cites; the inconsistency is the source's, not the post's.

claims.claim_text: hash 從 MurmurHash3 換成純 Julia 寫的 RapidhashNano，長字串從 8.555μs 降到 1.742μs，代價是自訂 hash 方法必須接受 seed 參數、而且不得給預設值
claims.evidence: The byte-hashing algorithm is now RapidhashNano … has moved from C to pure Julia for better readability and maintainability … 8.555 μs … 1.742 μs … Custom hash methods should always accept the seed as an argument like hash(x::MyType, h::UInt) and never provide a default value
claims.note: Both timings and the seed-argument requirement (including the 'never provide a default' half) are in the source.

claims.claim_text: @spawn 改成只叫醒一個 thread 而不是全部閒置 thread，官方量到 16 核 Linux 上 1.1 到 1.6 倍、Windows 上 10 到 300 倍
claims.evidence: @spawn wakes one idle thread in the task's threadpool instead of every thread … 1.1-1.6x on a 16-core Linux machine, to 10-300x on Windows and heavily oversubscribed machines
claims.note: Faithful. The source attributes the 10-300x range to 'Windows and heavily oversubscribed machines'; the lede narrows it to Windows, which understates the scope rather than overstating the result.

claims.claim_text: 同一份 Geekbench 7 工作負載走過翻譯之後，執行的 aarch64 指令數大約是原生 x86-64 的兩倍
claims.evidence: A Geekbench 7 workload will execute roughly twice as many aarch64 instructions as x86-64 ones when going through binary translation, as a rule of thumb.
claims.note: The lede keeps both hedges the source uses ('roughly', 'as a rule of thumb' → 「大約」、「粗略法則」). Geekbench version is 7, matching the post.

claims.claim_text: 測試平台是 Snapdragon X2 Elite，對照組是 Neoverse N1 與 N2
claims.evidence: the Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme X2E-96-100 in an Asus Zenbook A16 laptop … Qualcomm's E-Cores manage to outperform Neoverse N1 even when taking a binary translation penalty. … Neoverse N2 starts off at lower IPC and curiously fails to gain much IPC when running x86-64 under binary translation.
claims.note: Re-fetched to confirm Neoverse N1/N2 actually appear and serve as comparison cores — they do. The source also runs Azure Arm instances, which the lede omits.

claims.claim_text: 其中 AVX 對應到 NEON 的影片播放負載罰得最重、低 IPC 的導航負載罰得最輕
claims.evidence: Video Player is a well vectorized workload that takes advantage of AVX instructions. Score differences in that test are absolutely massive. … Navigation is a low IPC workload that's heavily bound by branch prediction and backend memory latency, and takes a comparatively low penalty when run under binary translation.
claims.note: Directionally exact, and both mechanisms (AVX vectorization; low IPC / branch-and-latency bound) match. Mild hardening: the source's wording is comparative ('absolutely massive', 'comparatively low penalty') rather than an explicit most/least ranking, while the lede says 「罰得最重／最輕」. Not severe enough to change meaning — these two are the extremes of the range the source presents.

claims.claim_text: 漏掉的是迴圈裡沒必要的 register spill 與嚴格 register mapping 逼出來的多餘指令
claims.evidence: Prism carries out the FMA operation with a pair of FMLA instructions, but curiously spills NEON register holding the high half of ymm7 to the stack. It does this again for all eight of the loop's FMA instructions, which doubles cache bandwidth demands. … Prism introduces significant instruction overhead by trying to maintain a register mapping where x86 SSE registers map to the equivalently numbered aarch64 NEON register.
claims.note: Both halves confirmed by targeted re-fetch: the spill is inside a loop and the source calls it 'completely unnecessary'; the strict register mapping is named as a source of instruction overhead.

claims.claim_text: 作者的結論是這條路走不走得通，靠的是硬體本身夠快，不是翻譯器多聰明
claims.evidence: The ultimate answer to binary translation's consequences is to have a high performance architecture with few weaknesses in the first place.
claims.note: Attributed as the author's conclusion in the post, and it is the source's own closing framing.

claims.claim_text: Homebrew 7.0.0 在 9 月 13 日發布，新的 brew vulns 直接拿已安裝的 formula 去比對漏洞，背後是內建的 OSV 格式 advisory 資料庫、以 CC0 釋出，不必再外掛第三方 tap
claims.location: #item-06 lede（H2「brew 自己帶了一份漏洞清單」）
claims.evidence: Today, I'm proud to announce Homebrew 7.0.0 … brew vulns is built in, checking known vulnerabilities using OSV.dev without another tap or gem. … Homebrew's new advisory database records vulnerabilities against the formula versions and revisions Homebrew ships. … OSV-format records are freely reusable under CC0.
claims.note: Release date, command, OSV format, CC0 licence and the no-extra-tap point all supported.

claims.claim_text: Linux 從 Bubblewrap 換成 Landlock、不需要提權，macOS 的 cask 沙箱則限制啟動應用程式、Mach service 與 Unix socket 連線，沙箱建置預設也擋掉讀家目錄
claims.evidence: Homebrew 7.0.0 replaces it with Landlock, requiring no dependencies or escalated Docker permissions. … application launching, Mach services and Unix socket connections … blocks sandboxed reads of the home directory by default.
claims.note: The three restricted cask operations match one-for-one. Minor generalization: the source says 'no dependencies or escalated Docker permissions' (Docker-specific), while the lede says 「不需要提權」 without the Docker qualifier.

claims.claim_text: Intel Mac 在 2026 年 9 月降到 tier 3，既有 bottle 留著、例行的 Intel bottle 更新已經停掉，更新過的 formula 可能得從原始碼建，而 Homebrew 在 Intel 上只跑到 2027 年 9 月為止
claims.evidence: Homebrew moves macOS Intel x86_64 to Tier 3 in September 2026 … existing bottles remain, but updated formulae may require source builds after unreliable infrastructure ended routine Intel bottle updates. … Homebrew still runs on Intel until September 2027, without project support or routine bottle builds. … | Running Homebrew on Intel Macs | Upcoming removal | 2027-09-01 | Apple Silicon or another package manager. |
claims.note: Round 2: re-fetched twice. All four sub-claims now hold — Tier 3 in September 2026; routine Intel bottle updates already ended (source clause is past tense); existing bottles remain and the 'may require source builds' hedge is preserved; and 2027-09 is now correctly labelled as when Homebrew stops running on Intel, not a bottle cutoff. Residual imprecision: the source gives 2027-09-01 while the post says 2027 年 9 月 — a month-level rendering of a first-of-month date, not a drift.

claims.claim_text: .pkg 安裝器則改成只支援 Apple Silicon 與 macOS Sequoia 15 以上
claims.evidence: Homebrew's .pkg installer is Apple Silicon only and requires macOS Sequoia 15 or later.
claims.note: Verbatim match.

claims.claim_text: 這篇 9 月 10 日投上 arXiv 的論文……他們寫的 py-kvcache 在 80k token 時從磁碟載入比 LMCache 快 2.0 倍、三層合起來快 1.23 倍
claims.location: #item-07 lede（H2「重算有時候比讀快取快」）
claims.evidence: At 80k tokens, py-kvcache loading from disk is 2.0x faster than LMCache, with preloading contributing 1.34x. With GPU, CPU, and disk caching enabled, it is 1.23x faster than LMCache …
claims.note: Submission date (10 September 2026), tool name and both speedup figures confirmed against the abstract.

claims.claim_text: 與原生 vLLM KV Offload 實作則差在約 4% 以內
claims.evidence: With GPU, CPU, and disk caching enabled, it is 1.23x faster than LMCache and within approximately 4% of the native vLLM KV Offload implementation.
claims.note: Round 2: the rewrite now mirrors the abstract's symmetric bound — 「差在約 4% 以內」 states closeness without asserting which side is faster. The round-1 signed claim is gone, so hedge inflation is resolved. The comparison target is corrected to the abstract's 'native vLLM KV Offload implementation'. The 4% figure's configuration context (GPU+CPU+disk) carries over from the same sentence.

claims.claim_text: 而且在 H100 上很多請求根本跨不過外部快取划算的那道門檻
claims.evidence: Bailian trace replays improve TTFT on a weaker GPU, but on an H100 the average request falls below the break-even point and GPU memory alone retains enough prefixes.
claims.note: Supported, and stated more weakly than the source: the abstract says the AVERAGE request falls below break-even, the lede says 「很多請求」. Deflation is never an error.

claims.claim_text: 作者的說法是快取表現取決於傳輸粒度、中間記憶體用量，以及傳輸在什麼時機進入請求排程，而不只是裝置頻寬
claims.evidence: cache performance depends on transfer granularity, intermediate memory use, and when transfers enter the request schedule, not only on device bandwidth
claims.note: Near word-for-word rendering of the abstract's central finding, including the 'not only on device bandwidth' contrast, and visibly attributed in the post (「作者的說法是」).

claims.claim_text: C# 15 的 union 會跟著 .NET 11 一起出……JsonSerializer.Serialize(new IntOrString(42)) 序列化出來就是 42，沒有 wrapper、沒有 discriminator
claims.evidence: IntOrString uses the native union declaration introduced in C# 15 and .NET 11. … STJ serializes a union value as its active case, with nothing added to represent the union itself. The union wrapper is unpacked and only the active case is written.
claims.note: Version pairing confirmed by targeted re-fetch. Caveat on the code span: one fetch rendered the sample line as JsonSerializer.Serialize(new UnionIntString(42)); // 42 while the prose names the type IntOrString. Both identifiers appear in the article, so the lede's spelling is plausible but the exact sample line could not be pinned; the substantive claim (bare 42, no wrapper, no discriminator) is solid either way.

claims.claim_text: 只有走 System.Text.Json 的綁定來源能用，query string、route value、header 與 form field 都不行，因為 ?id=42 沒有任何線索說該綁 int 還是 string
claims.evidence: Binding sources that don't route through STJ don't support unions: Query string values, Route values, Header values, Form fields. … A single query value such as ?id=42 provides no way to know whether to bind int, string, Guid, or another case.
claims.note: All four excluded binding sources listed identically, and the ?id=42 rationale is the source's own. The source's list of candidate bindings is longer (int, string, Guid, or another case); the lede shortens it to int/string without contradiction.

claims.claim_text: 兩個 object case 就得掛上 [JsonUnion(TypeClassifier = typeof(JsonUnionTypeStructuralClassifier))] 靠屬性名字分辨，OpenAPI 那一側則是每個 case 一個 anyOf 條目
claims.evidence: When multiple cases could match the same JSON value, STJ needs help choosing one. … [JsonUnion(TypeClassifier = typeof(JsonUnionTypeStructuralClassifier))] … The OpenAPI document represents a union as an anyOf schema, with one entry per case type.
claims.note: The attribute string matches character-for-character, and the anyOf mapping is the source's own sentence.

claims.claim_text: NGINX 1.31.5 把 location 從 URL 比對裡解放出來，任何變數都能當成 location 的 traffic modifier，於是 location $vip、location $restricted_methods 這種寫法成立，判斷邏輯搬進 map
claims.location: #item-09 lede（H2「location 後面終於能放變數」）
claims.evidence: In September 2026 we introduced NGINX 1.31.5 with several core features for one same goal. … In NGINX 1.31.5, we removed this limitation and allowed any variable to become the traffic modifier for any location block. … Mapping of variables to values becomes crucial for predicate logic
claims.note: Version number and the 'any variable becomes the traffic modifier' phrasing are verbatim. Both example directives were re-fetched specifically: location $vip and location $restricted_methods both appear literally in the article's config samples.

claims.claim_text: 搭配 client_body_early_read 提早讀 request body、再用原生的 json_set 取出 JSON 欄位，routing 決策可以建立在 body 內容上，不必再掛一段 script
claims.evidence: Required for routing on the body … client_body_early_read … json_set $vip $request_body user.params.vip;
claims.note: Both directive names are the source's, and the json_set example shown extracts a JSON field from $request_body for routing without scripting.

claims.claim_text: 官方自己把代價講明：body 越大，處理吃的記憶體與 CPU 越多，所以簡單而常見的 predicate location 要擺在前面
claims.evidence: Larger request bodies take a lot of memory and CPU for processing … Place simple and popular predicate locations on the top of the list and more sophisticated ones towards the bottom
claims.note: Both the cost statement and the ordering advice are the vendor's own words, and the post attributes them to the vendor.

claims.claim_text: 自報 56 個欄位檢查、46 個欄位回報
claims.location: #item-10 lede（H2「一個識別碼，寫進七個地方」）
claims.evidence: Fields reported: 46 … Fields checked: 56
claims.note: Both counters read off the page itself, and the post correctly frames them as the page's self-report.

claims.claim_text: 它同時示範把同一個識別碼寫進七個地方、第八個藏在瀏覽器快取裡
claims.evidence: one identifier into seven places on your machine, and the server put an eighth into your browser's cache
claims.note: Seven plus one-in-cache matches exactly, including which party writes the eighth.

claims.claim_text: 並引熵值說 plugin 清單 11.1 bits、user agent 9.8 bits、字型 8.4 bits、canvas 8.3 bits、時區 3.3 bits，合計 63 bits，但自己補了一句「Entropy is only additive when signals are independent, and these are heavily correlated」
claims.evidence: Plugin lists contribute 11.1 bits; user agents 9.8 bits; fonts 8.4 bits; canvas rendering 8.3 bits; timezone 3.3 bits—totaling 63 bits maximum. … Entropy is only additive when signals are independent, and these are heavily correlated.
claims.note: All five entropy figures and the total match. The quoted English sentence is reproduced character-for-character inside 「」, and the post keeps the source's self-undercutting caveat rather than presenting 63 bits as a settled total.

claims.claim_text: 頁面也寫明幾乎所有值都在瀏覽器裡量完、不離開本機
claims.evidence: Almost every value here is measured in your browser and never leaves it.
claims.note: The post preserves the source's 'almost' hedge rather than claiming all values stay local.
